assert odd_validator(5) == 5, "Failed: 5 should be valid"

assert odd_validator(-3) == -3, "Failed: -3 should be valid (negative odd)"

    try:
        odd_validator(even)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Test script for MaxUtf8Bytes validator"""

# Test 1: Basic functionality
print("Test 1: Basic functionality")
test_cases = [
    ("abcd", 4, True),      # Exact limit
    ("abc", 4, True),       # Under limit
    ("", 4, True),          # Empty string
    ("abcde", 4, False),    # Over limit

    ("café", 3, False),     # UTF-8 multi-byte over limit
    ("hello", 5, True),
    ("hello", 4, False),
]

    is_valid = utf8_len <= max_bytes
    status = "✓" if is_valid == should_pass else "✗"
    print(f"{status} '{text}' ({utf8_len} bytes, max {max_bytes}): {is_valid}")

# Test 2: Error message formatting

formatted = error_msg.format(input="test", max=10)
print(f"✓ Default message: {formatted}")

custom_msg = "{input} exceeds {max} UTF-8 bytes"
formatted = custom_msg.format(input="toolong", max=5)
print(f"✓ Custom message: {formatted}")

print("\nAll manual tests passed!")
EOF
